desc: Parse S and T into runs (type, length) and compare total counts of 0s and 1s.
Implement reduction: while a zero-run of length >= X is immediately followed by a one-run of length >= Y, apply the operation A (swap blocks, split runs, merge neighbors).
Run reduction on both S and T to get their normal forms.
Compare the two normal forms; output "Yes" if equal, otherwise "No".
